name: workflow-observer
description: Local-first workflow observation, learning, and user-approved improvement for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Observe workflows locally and improve them with approval.
interface.longDescription: Workflow Observer records privacy-minimized local workflow lifecycles, supports portable and explicit LLM Wiki storage, analyzes sufficiently large finalized samples, and keeps every workflow improvement behind user approval.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Workflow Observer to record this eligible task locally, then explain the resulting lifecycle without exposing sensitive content.
